scoped_handle.description: Every read goes through an opaque scope handle of the form scoperef:<provider>:<name>. A handle that looks like a path, a connection string, or a storage driver URI is refused, and a scope names exactly one resource kind and the exact fields it may read.
scoped_handle.claim_boundary: The broker owns the mapping from handle to boundary. No caller is handed a path, a connection, or a storage handle.

query_contract.description: A query is declarative: a resource kind, a projection from the scope's allow-list, filters drawn from a closed operator set (eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, contains, prefix), a bounded row limit, and an optional opaque cursor. A field outside the allow-list, an unknown operator, a missing operand, an expression-like operand, an out-of-range limit, and a malformed cursor are all refused.
query_contract.claim_boundary: Comparison is local and lexical. This contract runs no statement against any datastore.

export_contract.description: An export declares a format (json, csv), a non-empty field selection inside the scope's allow-list, a bounded row limit, and a local destination. An unknown format, an empty or disallowed selection, an out-of-range limit, a non-local destination, and any credential-bearing field name are refused.
export_contract.claim_boundary: The export is serialized in memory. Writing a file, uploading, and sharing remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

audit.description: Every brokered action appends an entry with a monotonic sequence, the action, the resource, the decision, a short detail, and the time. A refused attempt is recorded too. The trail is append-only and exposes no method that removes or rewrites an entry, and the projection redacts the handle and any opaque reference.
audit.claim_boundary: The trail is in-memory and process-local. Tamper-evident and durable audit storage remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

revocation.description: Revoking a scope handle takes effect immediately: every later query and export on that handle is refused. Revocation is idempotent and is always possible, including for a handle this broker has never seen.
revocation.claim_boundary: Revocation is process-local. Cross-process and cross-device revocation propagation remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

no_direct_database.description: The broker exposes no member whose name mentions a path, a file, a directory, a statement, a connection, a database, a driver, a socket, or a credential, and it never returns a storage location. The dataset is private and reachable only through a scope handle.
no_direct_database.claim_boundary: This is a structural guarantee about this contract's surface. It does not prove anything about other code paths in the application.

acceptance_notes.canonical_fields: account: id, email_handle, plan; project: id, name, updated_at; novel: id, title, status; character: id, name, novel_ref; workspace: id, name, created_at
acceptance_notes.fail_closed: an unknown scope, a revoked scope, a resource mismatch, and a credential-bearing field are refused rather than coerced
